name: tenancy-demo
objective: Practice T02.1 baseline/variant authorization comparison on researcher-owned fixtures
scope_note: Localhost only. Two tenants, two accounts, one project. No external network.

endpoints./export (GET): export a project you own (X-Actor header selects the account)
endpoints./export (POST): create an export job for a project you own (R4-class state change)
endpoints./go-out: 302 to https://example.invalid/ (out-of-scope hop for gate tests)

expected_evidence: baseline 200 with project fields vs variant 403 error-only
